summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose routine ASX notifications regarding its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program. The filing reiterates the company's authorization to buy back Class A and Class B common stock from time to time, with no new terms, pricing, premium, or board recommendation. The disclosure is a procedural compliance step for its Australian listing, not a special-situation event. No deal mechanics, dates, or advisory roles are present. This is an ordinary capital-return activity update, not a capital return event or other special situation.
